name: worth-attention
description: Is one item worth a VIO researcher's attention today

worth.instructions: Is the item in `title` and `excerpt` worth the attention of a researcher developing visual-inertial odometry for UAVs, today? `taste_examples` lists items the reader liked or disliked.

criteria.true: A new method, result, dataset, benchmark, open-source release, negative result, survey or deadline that could change what a VIO researcher builds, cites or knows
criteria.false: A rehash, generic AI or robotics news, product marketing, funding news, rumor, a minor version bump or repo chore, or off topic for visual-inertial state estimation

novelty.instructions: How new is the information in `title` and `excerpt` for someone who already follows the VIO literature? A small tweak of a known pipeline is incremental.
